sn22.65:1.2: kho. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn22.65:1.3: sādhu me bhante bhagavā saṅkhittena …pe… pahitatto vihareyyanti.
sn22.65:2.1: yathākathaṃ pana tvaṃ bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāsīti.
sn22.65:2.2: rūpaṃ kho bhante abhinandamāno bandho mārassa
sn22.65:2.9: imassa khvāhaṃ bhante bhagavatā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmīti.
sn22.65:3.2: sādhu kho tvaṃ bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāsi.
sn22.65:3.3: rūpaṃ kho bhikkhu abhinandamāno bandho mārassa
sn22.65:3.10: imassa kho bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabboti …pe…
sn22.65:3.11: aññataro ca pana so bhikkhu arahataṃ ahosīti.
